d:
The Better India met the cast of Operation Safed Sagar for The Better Headline Challenge, where real stories covered by The Better India were mixed with fictional Bollywood plotlines.
The challenge? Guess which stories actually happened and which ones were made up! 🏻
From unbelievable real-life heroes to stories straight out of a movie, the cast had to separate fact from fiction, and some answers might surprise you!
Operation Safed Sagar, starring Siddharth, Jimmy Shergill, Abhay Verma and more, is now streaming on Netflix.
